description: Meridian tenant is indexed with the real MiniLM profile (not the deterministic embedder)
Every retrieved chunk for every search belongs to Meridian (and each search returned results)
Every citation emitted points at a current Meridian-owned chunk
Every emitted citation quote is verbatim text of the cited chunk
The out-of-scope question received no answer and no citations
Asset ID extracted exactly as written in every report that contains one
Priority equals the tenant's deterministic rule outcome for every extracted incident
The report without a vehicle ID is rejected (asset_not_identified) rather than guessed
Registered vehicles are verified against the fleet register; the unregistered VH-9999 is not
review_status is pending_review only when the vehicle is registered AND grounded evidence exists
No ticket can be drafted from an incident in needs_review (HTTP 409)
A supervisor-accepted incident for an UNREGISTERED vehicle still cannot be approved for release

error.message: Asset VH-9999 is not in the tenant's authoritative register; register it and re-verify the incident before external submission

description: Approved ticket was submitted once to Meridian's service desk and stored with a WO- id
Customer-specific mapping applied: payload keys and urgency follow Meridian's connector config
Apex's maintenance ticketing system received nothing from Meridian's workflow
Audit trail contains every expected event type for the exercised workflow
Apex users cannot read or act on Meridian objects (and vice versa), and Apex retrieval never returns Meridian chunks
